findings.summary: 19 of the 100 foundation color-ramp steps (amber.50/200/400/500/700/800, brand.50/200/800, green.50/200/400/500/600/800, red.100/200/400/800) are pure ramp-completion filler: no semantic token in either theme aliases them and no component CSS references their custom properties. They are valid, well-typed and harmlessly inert, but they inflate the foundation token count without functional use.

The light theme's color.focus.ring token is classified confidence: "direct" even though its own $description admits 'the reference screens never capture a keyboard focus state' and the value is a reused hue, not a directly sampled instance of that role. The analogous foundation.focusRing (width/offset) geometry honestly classifies the identical missing-evidence situation as "inferred". This is a defensible but inconsistent edge case in an otherwise flawless direct/inferred discipline (light theme is otherwise 100% direct-with-evidence, dark theme 100% inferred, matching the v1-stack profile exactly).
